newsitem.title: USA: ATS Medical backs 1996 EPS estimates.
newsitem.headline: ATS Medical backs 1996 EPS estimates.

text.p: ATS Medical Inc President Richard Kramp said on Tuesday the company agreed with analysts' estimates that ATS will earn $0.06 to $0.07 a share for 1996.

"For the year, I've seen one or two cents more (than 1995's $0.05 a share), and that's in line with what our expectations are," Kramp said in an interview following a presentation at a Dain Bosworth investor conference here.
Kramp said a third quarter earnings estimate of $0.01 a share, flat with a year ago, was "fairly accurate."
He said in his presentation at the conference that ATS hoped to receive approval from the Food and Drug Administration to begin clinical studies of its heart valve by year-end.
"We hope to hear positively from the FDA in terms of starting our clincal studies by the end of the year," Kramp said. "The studies could take from two and half to three years."
Although the company's research and development costs dropped eight percent in the first half of 1996, to $329,000, Kramp said such expenses could soon increase.
"If we got FDA approval early in the fourth quarter for the clinicals to start, we could have a big jump in R&D expenses. But there would be offsetting revenues," he said.
